name: DirectorRecord
description: Records each appointed director of a BusinessCustomer as identified from the Companies House officer list at BPH-002. All current directors must be identified and individually verified (BPH-004) regardless of ownership percentage — MLR 2017 requires director screening even where the director holds no beneficial ownership. Directors are individually screened for PEP/sanctions status in BPH-005. The DirectorRecord links to the SVC-050 IdentityVerification record and to the Companies House officer_id for audit trail continuity and ongoing pKYC monitoring (e.g. director appointment/resignation changes trigger a pKYC review event).

fields.name: companies_house_officer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. Companies House officer ID (alphanumeric, returned in officers API response). Immutable. Used for ongoing CH monitoring.

fields.name: first_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–100 characters. Sourced from Companies House officer API at BPH-002.
fields.transparency_note: Personal data of a third party. Collected under MLR 2017 legal obligation (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(c)).

fields.name: appointment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Date of director appointment as registered at Companies House.

fields.name: resignation_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601. Null if currently appointed. A resigned director triggers a pKYC review event for the ongoing customer relationship.

fields.name: is_also_ubo
fields.validation_rule: Required. True if this director also has a UltimateBeneficialOwner record (>25% ownership). DirectorRecord and UBO record remain separate entities — they serve distinct MLR 2017 obligations.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | invited | in_progress | verified | failed | waived. Same semantics as UltimateBeneficialOwner.verification_status.

fields.name: verification_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when verification_status = verified. FK → IdentityVerification.verification_id (owned by SVC-050).

fields.name: cdd_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Same structure as UltimateBeneficialOwner.cdd_screening_result. Populated by SVC-014 at BPH-005.

relationships.description: A director who is also a UBO has a corresponding UltimateBeneficialOwner record (is_also_ubo = true). These are separate entities serving distinct MLR 2017 obligations.

design_decisions.decision: DirectorRecord is separate from UltimateBeneficialOwner even where the same individual is both director and UBO.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 imposes distinct obligations for directors and beneficial owners. A director with no ownership must still be verified; a UBO with no directorship must still be identified. Separate entities allow independent lifecycle management.
